title: From Scrapping To Recycling
summary:
Ship recycling enters a new era
Yesterday, on 26 June 2025, the Hong Kong International Convention for the Safe and Environmentally Sound Recycling of Ships (HKC) officially went into effect. The aim of this piece of regulation from the International Maritime Organization (IMO) is to improve the safety and environmental performance of ship recycling yards worldwide. The HKC has been a long time coming.
